card.name: Linking words joining parallel clauses
card.fires_on: The word 'and' (also 'to') that links two parallel items after a drug name or phrase, where a second matching clause is expected next. Common in opioid monitoring instructions and in lists of job qualifications.

modes.label: And after drug name
modes.description: 'and' after a drug name in monitoring advice, introducing a repeated 'when' clause.
modes.example: Regularly evaluate such patients, particularly when initiating and titrating APADAZ<< and>> when APADAZ is given concom

modes.label: Job qualification lists
modes.description: 'and' or 'to' in a list of qualifications before 'the ability to relocate'.
modes.example: Education professionals with internships, related work experience, advanced degrees and the ability<< to>> relocate should have the best employment opportunities.

card.plain: It fires on the small joining word that comes just before a repeated phrase in a parallel list.
